params.prompt: Make a tightly localized correction to the shoe in FIRST image only. SECOND image shows the exact original shoe in the same scene unobscured; use only its shoe construction, not its actor pose or playing card. Restore that original shoe: inclined uninterrupted white stack leading directly into the large black front mouth, with original thin sidewalls and black bottom tray/lip. Remove the invented thick gray horizontal block across the throat in the first image. Do not add a new divider, fascia, stock shoe, raised panel or alternate aperture. Preserve first image's low red-backed face-down card and the drawing fingertips pressing its exposed leading edge. The red BACK remains UP, low and almost flat; rear of card is naturally occluded within the original black mouth, exposed end passes over the existing low tray/lip. Preserve current hand/finger positions and natural sleeve-to-wrist contact; only the minimum true shoe/card occlusion boundary may adjust to restore original geometry. Keep all pixels outside this small shoe throat region visually unchanged: exact Astrid identity, face, hair, skin tone, both hands, wrist pose, body, black suit, ivory blouse, lighting, background, table text, camera framing and scale. Do not copy the second image's delivery pose or extra white card. No labels or annotations.
